title: Kicked Spicy Algerian Chicken Breast Tagine
description: A spicy and tender chicken dish originating from Algeria, made with chicken breast and a blend of aromatic spices, perfect for adventurous eaters and diabetic-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, onion, garlic, ginger, cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken breast to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Let the chicken marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Transfer the chicken to a large Dutch oven or heavy pot with a tight-fitting lid.
Pour in the chicken broth and bring the mixture to a boil.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through and the internal temperature reaches 165 degrees Fahrenheit.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Serve the chicken hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
